headline: Short Shorts win: 35 s or less get a median 563.5 views in 48 hours and 54.2% viewed, 15 times the 36-50 s ones. But no new Short has gone out since 6 Nov.

working.text: Shorts of 35 s or less: median 563.5 views in 48 h and 54.2% viewed (14 videos), vs 36.5 views and 36.6% for 36-50 s (22).
'Secret' hooks: median 708 views in 48 h (5 videos); 'challenge' 287.5 (4); 'conflict' 167 (4).
Cinematic music: median 53.9% viewed (10 videos), vs 37.4% for pop and 34.0% for lo-fi.

notWorking.text: 'Question' hooks: median 33.5 views in 48 h (14 videos) and 'myth' 27.5 (8), although the $10 gym myth Short got 908.
Acoustic music: median 16 views in 48 h (6 videos), against 206.5 for pop (10).
Long videos: 3 measured, at most 6 views in 48 h and 1.7-11.6% viewed.

audience.text: 28 days: India 35.4%, US 16.4%, Philippines 11.1%, Indonesia 8.1%, UK 6.1% of views.
Mobile 83.5% and tablet 10.9%; 92.7% of views come from the Shorts feed.
99.4% of views are from non-subscribers, who watch 52.0% on average vs 32.5% for subscribers.

recommendations.because: 35 s or less: median 563.5 views in 48 h (14 videos) vs 36.5 for 36-50 s (22).

recommendations.do: Use 'secret' hooks more often than 'question' hooks.
recommendations.because: Median 708 views in 48 h for secret (5 videos) vs 33.5 for question (14).

recommendations.do: Make more 'how a famous business really makes money' Shorts like the $10 gym.
recommendations.because: It got 908 views in 48 h at 27 s, 12.5 times the median of 72.5.
